title: Enhance SVG output with interactivity
description:
Follow-up to SVG review: implement enhancements:

Improvements:
- Better styling (improved colors, fonts, spacing)
- Hover tooltips showing full issue details (title, description, status)
- Visual highlighting of critical paths
- Proper edge routing (avoid overlaps)
- Responsive sizing based on graph complexity
- Export option: standalone HTML with embedded JavaScript for interactivity

Consider:
- Click to jump to issue in terminal (if possible)
- Zoom/pan for large graphs
- Filter toggle buttons in HTML export

This creates production-quality SVG suitable for documentation and sharing.
